recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If PA/Gender Harmony wants LOINC 76689-9 exposed directly in Patient narrative again, handle that through a new current decision rather than by replaying the STU3 wording.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient issue requesting that the Patient Gender and Sex section add LOINC 76689-9 as the code to use when representing sex assigned at birth as an Observation.
initial_application: Git commit 42c4df50f2 applied the request by adding the LOINC 76689-9 Observation sentence to source/patient/patient-notes.xml. The Patient resource remains active in source/fhir.ini, so this narrative is build-scoped.
additional_context: FHIR-29673 later introduced Gender Harmony SPCU and Recorded Sex or Gender guidance for Patient sex/gender exchange. FHIR-39203 later decided to move exchange recommendations out of the FHIR base Patient narrative and into the Gender Harmony Implementation Guide. The current Patient sex-and-gender example still demonstrates LOINC 76689-9 as the recordedSexOrGender type code.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because restoring the old 2018 Observation sentence would duplicate and partially reverse the later Gender Harmony guidance now reflected in the current Patient source.
